text: Made like cottage cheese, but the washed curd is sold as it is, undressed. The standard names no culture species.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Of sweet skim milk, concentrated skim milk or nonfat dry milk, with calcium chloride up to 0.02 %.
Lactic acid bacteria are added and the milk held until it coagulates.

processing.text: Route 1 of the standard: culture added, held until it coagulates, then cut, warmed, stirred, drained and washed. Two other routes set the curd with food acid, or acid and GDL (pH 4.5-4.8), instead; species are not named.
